text:
Sofia Park: Quick company update — pleased to announce Rajiv Malhotra is joining Redwood Inference as Director, Inference Reliability, starting Apr 14. He'll lead site reliability for inference, observability, and reliability-focused model rollouts. :tada:

Priya Natarajan: awesome — congrats Rajiv! Can you confirm the org/reporting line?

Sofia Park: Rajiv reports to Priya (Head of Runtime) for day-to-day. Strategic partnership with Product (Jordan) and Observability will move under Eng Runtime to reduce cross-team handoffs. Change effective Apr 14.

Evan Carter: big win. timeline for backfills? we'll need a senior SRE and a monitoring PM on the roadmap.

Sofia Park: Good point. Marina Lopez will act as interim Observability lead while we open the search. Hiring plan: 1x Senior Reliability Eng (req in recruiting this week), 1x Monitoring PM (Q2). ETA: interviews start Apr 20.

Marina Lopez: I can take the interim lead tasks. will create a handoff doc and sync with the current observability owners this week.

Lizzy Mendoza: @Sofia please send the updated org card to people-ops so we can update job ladders and comp bands. Also I'll trigger the onboarding checklist for Rajiv.

HR Bot: New hire checklist created for Rajiv Malhotra — onboarding buddy assigned (Evan Carter), access requests queued (KMS, VPC logs, Sentry).

Evan Carter: happy to be the buddy. small ask: can we lock in a 1:1 week one w/ runtime and platform leads to align expectations?

Sofia Park: Yes — I've scheduled a 30m sync Apr 15 with Priya, Jordan, Rajiv, and Marina. Calendar invite to follow.

Priya Natarajan: We'll also run a quick dependency review across Dedicated + Private teams to avoid surprises for rollout windows.

Sofia Park: FYI this shift is mostly structural — no immediate headcount change to Observability beyond the planned hires. It's about centralizing reliability under Runtime to speed incident remediation and model rollout SLAs.

Marina Lopez: I'll post the interim runbook and access list in #eng-oncall by EOD Friday.

Lizzy Mendoza: For managers: please update your 1:1 cadences if you had observability folks on your team — people-ops will help coordinate.

Priya Natarajan: Thanks everyone. Welcome, Rajiv! Ping me if anything blocks hiring approvals.

Rajiv Malhotra: Hi all — excited to join Redwood. Looking forward to meeting the team and digging into the runbooks. Happy to take any immediate onboarding reading recs!

Sofia Park: Welcome again Rajiv — will DM a short reading list and the org doc. :wave:
